title: House + carport for 2 cars (6.6 x 6.0 m)
description: The whole house as traced (both floors: walls, windows, doors, floors, the stair, fireplace and built-ins; electrical fixtures left out) next to option 1, the 6.6 x 6.0 m two-car carport with the solar roof, on the real pad. North up like the map: the back-door wall faces the pad, the front-door wall faces the road. Cars parked as in option 1, where the Multivan stands over the back step.
anchored: A house and a carport on ground screws: nothing to tip over.

x0.label: Gap between house wall and roof edge

W.label: Roof width (along the house wall's side, x)

h_front.label: Top of the front (road / north) beam

pitch.label: Roof pitch (falls toward the garden / south)

oh_side.label: Roof overhang past the end posts

oh_front.label: Roof overhang north of the front posts

oh_back.label: Roof overhang south of the back posts

height_max.label: Highest point (roof sheet at the road edge)

gl_post.name: Glulam GL30c 140x140 (post)
gl_post.notes: Glulam is ordered cut to length; 6 m is a common stock length.

parts.name: Post, front (road)
parts.role: Carries the front (road / north) beam down to a ground screw. Sized and spaced so walls and a door can be added later.

parts.name: Post, back (garden)
parts.role: Carries the back (low / garden) beam. Shorter than the front posts because the roof falls toward the garden.

parts.name: Beam, front (road)
parts.role: Front (high / road) beam on top of the front posts; the rafters sit on it.

parts.name: Beam, back (garden)
parts.role: Back (low / garden) beam on top of the back posts.

parts.name: Knee brace, front
parts.role: Diagonal between post and beam. Stops the frame racking sideways along its length (wind, a nudge from a car).

parts.name: Knee brace, back
parts.role: Diagonal between post and beam. Stops the frame racking sideways along its length (wind, a nudge from a car).

parts.name: Rafter
parts.role: Spans from the back beam to the front beam, rising toward the road so rain and snow run off to the garden. Fixed with a rafter tie at each beam.
parts.notes: About 5.3 m between the beams: check the span against the snow load in the design project (45x220 at 600 c/c is at the limit; 400 c/c or 45x245 if needed).

parts.name: Roof batten, piece 1
parts.role: Across the rafters; the steel roof sheets are screwed to these. Joints fall on a rafter.

parts.name: Roof batten, piece 2
parts.role: Across the rafters; the steel roof sheets are screwed to these. Joints fall on a rafter.

parts.name: Roof sheet
parts.role: Profiled steel sheet with anti-condensation felt (so it does not drip on the cars).

parts.name: Solar panel, row 1
parts.role: Solar panels on rails over the roof sheet. The roof falls to the south (garden), so the panels face south.

parts.name: Solar panel, row 2
parts.role: Solar panels on rails over the roof sheet. The roof falls to the south (garden), so the panels face south.

parts.name: Solar panel, row 3
parts.role: Solar panels on rails over the roof sheet. The roof falls to the south (garden), so the panels face south.

parts.name: VW Multivan T6.1 (2021)
parts.role: VW Multivan T6.1 (2021), to check the fit. Reference only: not in the cut list.

parts.name: VW Golf Alltrack (2017)
parts.role: VW Golf Alltrack (2017), to check the fit. Reference only: not in the cut list.

parts.name: Cargo bike
parts.role: Cargo bike, about 2.7 m long, behind the Alltrack (which is shorter than the Multivan).

parts.name: Parking pad (pavers), main part
parts.role: The existing paved pad, 58 m2 (Top view is north-up like the map: road at the top, garden at the bottom). Measured on the cadastral: 10.29 m along the road, 11.72 m along the garden, 6.1 m at the house, 4.57 m at the east end.

parts.name: Parking pad, garden-side wedge
parts.role: Part of the pad: it is deeper at the house end (6.1 m) than at the east end (4.4-4.6 m).

parts.name: Parking pad, east wedge
parts.role: Part of the pad: the east edge slants outward toward the garden.

parts.name: Plot boundary, road side (approx.)
parts.role: Boundary with the road-side strip, about 3.5 m north of the pad (measured on the map).

parts.name: Plot boundary with 0127 (approx.)
parts.role: Boundary with plot 0127, about 2 m from the east end of the pad. Under 4 m means EI60 walls and, in Tallinn, a written agreement with the neighbour.

parts.name: Cable corridor protection zone (approx.)
parts.role: Low-voltage cables run 4-5 m north of the pad's front edge, with about 1 m protection zone each side. No digging or footings here without Elektrilevi's consent.

parts.name: Service cables from 1239, zone (approx.)
parts.role: AXPK 4x25 service cables leave distribution point 1239 heading south then east, about 2 m from the pad's NE corner. Positions on utility maps can be off by a metre; order an on-site marking.

parts.name: Distribution point 1239 (Haabersti)
parts.role: Elektrilevi distribution point on the neighbouring land, just past the NE corner of the pad.
